title: Sindh Public Property Removal of Encroachment Amendment Act 2011

sections.shortTitle: Sindh Public Property Removal of Encroachment Amendment Act 2011
sections.description:
Short title and commencement

ACT VI OF 2011
ACT VI OF 2011
SINDH PUBLIC PROPERTY
(REMOVAL OF
ENCROACHMENT)
(AMENDMENT) ACT, 2011
An Act to amend the Sindh
Public Property
(Removal of
Encroachment) Act, 2010.
[Gazette of Sindh, Extraordinary, Part-IV,
1st March, 2011]
No.PAS/Legis-B-2/2011,
dated 24-2-2011.---The Sindh Public Property (Removal
of Encroachment) (Amendment) Bill, 2011 having been passed by the Provincial
Assembly of Sindh on 14th January, 2011 and assented
to by the Governor of Sindh on 17th February, 2011 is
hereby published as an Act of the Legislature of Sindh.
Preamble.--Whereas
it is expedient to amend the Sindh Public Property
(Removal of Encroachment) Act, 2010 in the manner hereinafter appearing;
It is hereby
enacted as follows:--
1. Short title
and commencement.---(1) This Act may be called the
Sindh Public Property (Removal of Encroachment)
(Amendment) Act, 2011.
(2) It shall come
into force at once.

Amendment of sections 2 and 26 of Sindh Act XVIII of 2010

(AMENDMENT) ACT, 2011
An Act to amend the Sindh
Public Property
(Removal of
Encroachment) Act, 2010.
[Gazette of Sindh, Extraordinary, Part-IV,
1st March, 2011]
No.PAS/Legis-B-2/2011,
dated 24-2-2011.---The Sindh Public Property (Removal
of Encroachment) (Amendment) Bill, 2011 having been passed by the Provincial
Assembly of Sindh on 14th January, 2011 and assented
to by the Governor of Sindh on 17th February, 2011 is
hereby published as an Act of the Legislature of Sindh.
Preamble.--Whereas
it is expedient to amend the Sindh Public Property
(Removal of Encroachment) Act, 2010 in the manner hereinafter appearing;
It is hereby
enacted as follows:--
2. Amendment of
sections 2 and 26 of Sindh Act XVIII of 2010.--In
the Sindh Public Property (Removal of Encroachment)
Act, 2010--
(i) in section 2, after clause (o),
the following new clause shall be added:--
"(oo) "Special Court" means a Special Court
established under section 25;";
(ii) for section 26, the following shall be substituted:--
"26. A
Special Court shall consist of a retired Sessions Judge to be appointed by
Government.".
